_comment: The one list of open-source projects that system-optimize and its tray app use, integrate or build on. The About screen is generated from it; tests/test_credits.py checks it against docs/tools.md.

projects.name: system-optimize (original)
projects.role: The original script this tool grew from

projects.name: tuned
projects.role: Tuning daemon and profiles; tuned-ppd provides power profiles on Fedora

projects.name: power-profiles-daemon
projects.role: Power profile switching on many desktops

projects.name: systemd
projects.role: systemd-oomd, timers, sysctl.d and user services

projects.name: zram-generator
projects.role: Compressed RAM swap

projects.name: earlyoom
projects.role: Early out-of-memory handling where systemd-oomd is not used

projects.name: nohang
projects.role: Alternative low-memory handler

projects.name: irqbalance
projects.role: Spreads interrupts across CPU cores

projects.name: util-linux
projects.role: fstrim and fstrim.timer for SSD trim

projects.name: TLP
projects.role: Detected so its settings are not fought over

projects.name: auto-cpufreq
projects.role: Detected so its settings are not fought over

projects.name: thermald
projects.role: Thermal management on Intel machines

projects.name: sysbench
projects.role: CPU and memory benchmarks

projects.name: fio
projects.role: Disk benchmarks

projects.name: stress-ng
projects.role: Benchmark fallback

projects.name: ananicy-cpp
projects.role: Process priorities for responsiveness

projects.name: GameMode
projects.role: On-demand performance mode for games

projects.name: uresourced
projects.role: Gives the active desktop user's session more CPU, memory and I/O weight

projects.name: profile-sync-daemon
projects.role: Browser profiles in RAM

projects.name: plocate
projects.role: Fast file name search

projects.name: polkit
projects.role: Asks for your password before the tray changes anything

projects.name: Qt
projects.role: The tray app's interface

projects.name: Qt for Python (PySide6)
projects.role: Python bindings for Qt

projects.name: PyQt6
projects.role: Alternative Qt bindings, used when PySide6 is absent

projects.name: GNOME Shell
projects.role: The panel extension runs inside it

projects.name: libnotify
projects.role: Desktop notifications for agent suggestions

projects.name: Python
projects.role: The tray app, its backend and the agent

projects.name: SQLite
projects.role: Benchmark and resource history

projects.name: Ollama
projects.role: Runs the agent's local model

projects.name: llama.cpp
projects.role: Local model server for the agent, and llama-bench for the tokens/s benchmark

projects.name: Qwen3
projects.role: The agent's default model (qwen3:4b)

projects.name: bats-core
projects.role: Shell test framework

projects.name: ShellCheck
projects.role: Shell linting

projects.name: amd-debug-tools
projects.role: amd-ttm sets how much system RAM an AMD integrated GPU may map, for local models

projects.name: LACT
projects.role: AMD GPU power, clocks and fans; system-optimize leaves the GPU to it when lactd runs

projects.name: sched-ext/scx
projects.role: sched_ext CPU schedulers written in BPF

projects.name: scx-loader
projects.role: Starts and switches sched_ext schedulers

projects.name: bpftune
projects.role: Tunes network buffers from live traffic; the sysctl step leaves its keys alone

projects.name: btrfsd
projects.role: Btrfs scrubs on AC power and when errors show

projects.name: btrfsmaintenance
projects.role: Scheduled Btrfs scrub, balance and trim scripts

projects.name: Linux kernel
projects.role: MGLRU, transparent hugepages, pressure stall information and amd-pstate

projects.name: amdgpu_top
projects.role: VRAM and shared GPU memory (GTT) readings, per process

projects.name: Performance Co-Pilot
projects.role: Long-term resource history when it is installed

projects.name: psi-notify
projects.role: The pressure thresholds the tray's alerts use

projects.name: nvtop
projects.role: GPU monitor; counts VRAM and GTT on APUs

projects.name: btop
projects.role: Terminal resource monitor

projects.name: below
projects.role: Records cgroup, process and pressure history

projects.name: hyperfine
projects.role: Command benchmarking

projects.name: CachyOS-Settings
projects.role: Tuned defaults and the sched_ext and ananicy-cpp findings
